reading_comparisons.theme: The council label is described as a fluid group
reading_comparisons.observation: The June introduction describes Council of Contact as a loose name and a changing collective of higher selves. The September recording likewise explains council as a group name rather than a hierarchy.
reading_comparisons.interpretation: Represent this as a source-specific claimed collective; the source itself does not support treating the name as a stable institution or equating it with every Galactic Council.

reading_comparisons.observation: The October introduction distinguishes visible, physical landings from prior inner or partly perceived encounters. The September message says contact can occur through impressions, telepathy and a spirit-team relationship without a landed ship or shared observation.
reading_comparisons.interpretation: Code physical/public and private/experiential contact separately. Shared use of the word contact does not establish a shared observable outcome; this comparison does not evaluate whether contact occurred.

reading_comparisons.theme: Personal encounters, disclosure and global landings
reading_comparisons.observation: The June episode says isolated contact can precede disclosure and presents the timetable as contingent on human response. October places personal contact before global landings and describes a frequency grid, while declining to give a fixed tipping-point number.
reading_comparisons.interpretation: The material supports comparing narrative sequences and changing time references. It does not provide a validated forecast model, a fixed measurable threshold or independently verified event outcomes.

reading_comparisons.observation: The October message rejects a rescue narrative and emphasizes intention, curiosity, meditation and changes in one’s own responses and relationships. It discusses healing and financial abundance in the same spiritual framework.
reading_comparisons.interpretation: These are recommendations made within the source discourse, not verified medical, financial or physical mechanisms, and not advice generated by this research.

reading_comparisons.theme: Soul contracts are a topic, not a council name
reading_comparisons.observation: The October Contact recording mentions soul contracts when discussing who experiences contact. Separate publisher descriptions explicitly discuss soul-contract exercises associated with angels or dragons.
reading_comparisons.interpretation: Do not use keyword matches for contract, contracts or contracting to rename the council. These are useful nearby-topic controls, not evidence that Contract and Contact are aliases.

reading_coverage.scope: All three complete retained ASRs were read for the bounded comparisons above; no diarization, waveform alignment or clinical/physical claim verification.
